body:
# How GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, Luna compare on intelligence vs cost

GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna are ahead of Terra at every point on the Intelligence vs Cost per Task chart. GPT-5.6 Luna stands out as a particularly cost efficient model

Charting the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index shows the trade-off between intelligence and Cost per Intelligence Index Task. Across reasoning efforts, each GPT-5.6 model pushes past GPT-5.5 on the Pareto frontier (excluding non-reasoning).

However, Luna and Sol are always ahead of Terra. This means for any Terra effort level, there is a Luna or Sol effort level that is more intelligent at no extra cost, or as intelligent at lower cost.

Compare GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna with other leading models at https://artificialanalysis.ai

### Announcing Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.2

We are accelerating elements of our upcoming v5 release with interim updates to keep pace with the frontier. Index v4.2 has more complex and realistic tasks, and more private test sets to prevent gaming

### Benchmarking GPT-6 Astra

GPT-6 Astra makes significant gains in the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, scoring equal to Fable 5 at lower cost. In the Intelligence Index, it uses fewer tokens than GPT-5.6 Sol for similar performance, but this is outweighed by higher prices

summaryZh: Artificial Analysis发布了针对GPT-5.6系列模型（Sol, Terra, Luna）的最新性能评估。报告指出，GPT-5.6系列在智能与成本的帕累托前沿（Pareto frontier）上表现优异，其中Luna模型在保持高智能水平的同时展现了极高的成本效益。通过对比Intelligence Index与Cost per Task，该分析揭示了不同推理努力程度下的模型表现差异，并强调了GPT-5.6在处理复杂任务时相比前代产品的显著提升。此外，报告还提及了GPT-6 Astra在编码代理任务中的初步表现，进一步完善了当前大模型性能评估的基准体系。

glossary.explanationZh: 帕累托前沿，指在资源分配中，无法在不损害其他指标的情况下改善某一指标的状态，常用于衡量模型智能与成本的最优平衡点。
由Artificial Analysis开发的综合评估指标，用于量化大模型的推理能力与任务处理水平。
单任务成本，衡量模型在执行特定基准测试时的经济效率。
专门针对AI编程代理能力的评估基准，测试模型在代码生成与调试任务中的表现。
Token效率，指模型在完成相同任务时消耗的输出Token数量，反映了模型的推理成本控制能力。
